summary: Overlapping weapons fire and Gate stabilization pulses push Auric’s reciprocal-field geometry into the same echo behavior first measured in the Calm Corridor.
panelPlan: Establish EXT. AURIC GATE — CONTINUOUS. The Rift shudders under overlapping weapons fire and Gate stabilization pulses.
Duplicate ships begin appearing at the edges of synchronized formations—first one, then several.
Final consequence/reaction beat. Targeting systems multiply boxes faster than crews can identify real hulls.
directionInline: The Rift shudders as synchronized weapons fire overlays the Gate’s stabilization cycle. Anchor and shear displays remain readable while duplicate hull states begin appearing at the edges of repeated formations—first one, then several. Treat this as the dangerous recurrence of a measured physical phenomenon, not ghosts materializing because people believe in them.

summary: Pike refuses the ceasefire and Billie breaks his ability to turn the remaining chaos into a massacre.
settingText: EXT. AURIC GATE — BROKEN OATH / ASHFANG — CONTINUOUS
panelPlan: Broken Oath continues firing while target boxes disappear from ships around it.
Billie lines Ashfang up behind Pike and tells him to move.
Pike, ecstatic, says he is taking the Gate and refuses.
Billie: 'No. You're blocking my shot.' Her reticle is now clearly on Broken Oath's weapon mast.
Ashfang fires. Broken Oath's mast dies; the ship survives, suddenly unable to continue the massacre.
directionInline: Pike keeps firing after surrounding ships begin dropping target locks. Billie lines Ashfang up behind Broken Oath and tells him to move. Pike assumes she wants his firing lane and refuses. Billie's last line is true only in the most literal sense: her shot is aimed at Broken Oath's weapon mast. She fires and disables it without destroying the ship.
